title: The Pitch Falls Silent: Italian Football Bids Farewell to Beloved Icon Igor Protti
summary: Italian football is in mourning following the passing of beloved legend Igor Protti after a prolonged battle with illness. His death leaves a profound void in the sport, remembering him for his prolific career and unwavering passion that endeared him to fans across the nation.
content:
The pitch across Italy has fallen silent, draped in a collective sigh of sorrow as the football world mourns the passing of Igor Protti. An undeniable legend of the beautiful game, Protti, whose career embodied unwavering passion and a relentless pursuit of goal, has died after a prolonged battle with illness, his family announced today. His departure leaves a profound void, etching a sad day into the annals of Italian football history.

Protti was more than just a striker; he was a symbol. A journeyman in the purest sense, he built an extraordinary legacy through sheer grit and a prolific knack for finding the back of the net, often for clubs where he became an undisputed icon. Renowned for his unerring instinct in front of goal and his infectious dedication, he endeared himself to the hearts of countless supporters, transforming every match into a testament of his commitment. His ability to elevate teams and consistently deliver moments of brilliance, even in challenging circumstances, earned him a unique place in the pantheon of Italian football.

His presence on the field was electric, a whirlwind of skill and determination that inspired teammates and captivated crowds. Off the pitch, he was remembered for his humility and approachability, further cementing his status as a beloved figure. The outpouring of tributes from former clubs, teammates, and fans alike paints a vivid picture of a man who transcended the game, leaving an indelible mark not just with his goals, but with his character.

As the football community grapples with this significant loss, Protti’s legacy will undoubtedly live on. He represented an era of pure, unadulterated football, a testament to what dedication and heart can achieve. Though the final whistle has blown on his earthly journey, the echoes of his triumphs and the spirit he infused into Italian football will resonate for generations to come.
keyTakeaways: Italian football icon Igor Protti has died after a long illness.
Protti was widely celebrated for his prolific career and deep connection with fans.
His passing marks a significant loss, prompting an outpouring of grief across the sport.
author: OneFootball

title: Kiwi Telecom Giant One NZ Dials Up AI Ambitions, Shakes Up Oracle Strategy with Rimini Street Partnership
summary: New Zealand telecommunications provider One NZ has partnered with Rimini Street to revolutionize its Oracle software support and accelerate its artificial intelligence initiatives. This strategic move aims to future-proof its core systems while redirecting resources towards advanced innovation and customer experience enhancements.
content:
In a significant move signaling a shift in enterprise IT strategy, New Zealand telecommunications giant One NZ has announced a strategic partnership with Rimini Street, a leading third-party provider of software support. The collaboration is set to fundamentally reshape how One NZ manages its extensive Oracle estate, positioning the company for advanced AI innovation and long-term operational agility.

For a major telecommunications provider like One NZ, maintaining a resilient yet agile IT backbone is paramount. Traditional vendor support models often come with escalating costs and limited flexibility, diverting crucial resources that could otherwise fuel innovation. This partnership with Rimini Street allows One NZ to move beyond conventional support, extending the lifespan and optimizing the performance of its existing Oracle systems.

Crucially, this isn't just about cutting operational costs; it's a calculated play to future-proof One NZ's core infrastructure while simultaneously accelerating its foray into artificial intelligence. By offloading the complexities of legacy software maintenance to Rimini Street, One NZ can reallocate its engineering talent and budget towards developing cutting-edge AI-driven services and enhancing customer experiences across its network. The goal is to unlock new possibilities for data analysis, automation, and personalized offerings.

This strategic pivot underscores a growing trend among large enterprises to challenge conventional software support paradigms, seeking more agile and cost-effective pathways to digital transformation. For One NZ, the partnership with Rimini Street represents a decisive step towards building a more future-resilient technology foundation, one that prioritizes innovation and empowers the company to lead in an increasingly AI-driven landscape.
keyTakeaways: One NZ is transitioning from traditional Oracle vendor support to Rimini Street's third-party services.
The partnership aims to future-proof One NZ's existing Oracle systems, optimize performance, and reduce operational costs.
This strategic shift is designed to free up internal resources and budget, enabling One NZ to accelerate its investment and innovation in artificial intelligence.
author: Rutuparna Rath

title: London's Reality TV Darling Nessie Welschinger Inks Deal with Rizzo: A New Era for Influencer Representation?
summary: Nessie Welschinger, breakout star of 'The Real Housewives of London,' has officially signed with the innovative, female-focused Rizzo The Agency for exclusive representation. This partnership signals a strategic move to amplify Welschinger's commercial reach and brand collaborations, highlighting the evolving landscape of talent management in the digital age.
content:
The bustling intersection of reality television and digital influence just got a significant new player. Nessie Welschinger, a breakout personality from 'The Real Housewives of London,' has officially joined Rizzo The Agency, a move that’s sending ripples across the talent management landscape and underscoring a strategic shift in how stars build their empires.

Rizzo, gaining traction for its distinctly forward-thinking and female-focused approach, isn't just another agency. It positions itself as a dynamic force, dedicated to empowering its roster with robust, tailored support. This bespoke strategy extends across lucrative commercial partnerships and intricate brand collaborations, an increasingly critical domain for personalities whose authentic reach now extends far beyond traditional broadcast media into the vast digital sphere. Their emphasis on a female-centric model also speaks to a growing demand for representation that deeply understands the unique challenges and opportunities for women in the public eye.

For Welschinger, this exclusive representation signifies more than just a new agent; it’s a strategic alignment poised to leverage her burgeoning profile into a powerful, multifaceted commercial brand. In an era where reality TV stars are transforming into formidable digital entrepreneurs and key opinion leaders, agencies like Rizzo are actively reimagining the blueprint for sustained success. They offer bespoke pathways for their talent to not only thrive but also innovate across diverse platforms, from social media to bespoke product lines.

This high-profile deal between Welschinger and Rizzo isn't merely an individual career move; it reflects a broader, critical evolution in talent representation. Here, agile, digitally-savvy agencies are increasingly challenging established norms. As the lines between entertainment, authentic influence, and commerce continue to blur, partnerships of this nature offer a compelling glimpse into the future of celebrity brand building, propelled by strategic vision and a deep understanding of the modern, interconnected economy.
keyTakeaways: Nessie Welschinger's signing with Rizzo The Agency highlights the growing influence and commercial viability of reality TV stars in the digital age.
Rizzo's 'female-focused' model represents an innovative, tailored approach to talent management, emphasizing strategic brand partnerships and digital expansion.
The deal underscores a broader industry trend where agile, specialized agencies are reshaping traditional talent representation by focusing on entrepreneurial growth for their clients.
author: Max Goldbart

title: India's Green Tech Gets a Supercharge: ECOHUB.IN Launches to Nurture Climate Startups
summary: Resilience Actions, an initiative of Re Sustainability, has launched ECOHUB.IN, a new incubator targeting early-stage enterprises focused on climate and circular economy solutions in India. This move aims to accelerate sustainable innovation and tackle pressing environmental challenges across the nation.
content:
India, a nation at the forefront of economic growth and technological adoption, is now doubling down on its commitment to a greener future. A significant stride in this direction comes from Hyderabad, where Resilience Actions, the social and environmental arm of Re Sustainability, has just unveiled ECOHUB.IN.

This isn't just another startup accelerator; ECOHUB.IN is a dedicated sustainability incubator poised to be a pivotal force for early-stage enterprises. Its mission is laser-focused on nurturing ventures tackling critical issues within the climate and circular economy spheres. Think innovative solutions for waste management, renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, and resource efficiency – the very backbone of a resilient planet.

The timing couldn't be more crucial. India's rapid development necessitates robust, scalable solutions to mitigate environmental impact and foster a truly sustainable growth trajectory. ECOHUB.IN aims to fill a vital gap by providing these nascent companies with the mentorship, strategic partnerships, and access to capital often elusive in their early stages. By empowering these innovators, the hub seeks to accelerate the deployment of technologies and business models that can transform industries and communities across the subcontinent.

Ultimately, ECOHUB.IN isn't just about fostering individual startups; it's about cultivating a thriving ecosystem of climate-conscious innovation. It's about translating groundbreaking ideas into tangible impacts, creating jobs, and solidifying India’s position as a leader in global sustainability efforts. This initiative represents a clear signal that the future of Indian enterprise is inextricably linked with environmental stewardship.
keyTakeaways: ECOHUB.IN is a new sustainability incubator launched in Hyderabad by Resilience Actions.
It aims to support early-stage enterprises focused on climate and circular economy solutions in India.
The initiative seeks to accelerate sustainable innovation, create jobs, and foster India's green economy.
author: Staff Writer
